reviews.x: I’m an esthetician so I wanted to try one of these out and I’m satisfied, it’s exactly as described.

From the first use,I found the different sized rollers very comfortable and soothing.it certainly works my serums and toners much deeper into my skin. When I wake up my skin is not greasy like it used to be when those products would just sit at the surface overnight.I use the roller in the morning to wake me up before putting on make up and have started using it at night the last thing,because it  is so relaxing. I have to admit it has been a very good decision so far.I have been using the rolle

The jade roller is exactly what I want. Both oval jade rollers are smooth. The quality is very good. Even though it dropped to the wooden floor, it was not broken. I bought it for my mom to get rid of wrinkle. My mom likes it very much.
I have had mine for a while and it really helps with the lymphodema in my face.  It is so soothing and relaxing and helps with blood flow.  I love it!
I love my jade roller! Use it every morning and night. Feels amazing when used cold (sticking it in the fridge for a while).

I dont have anything bad to say, but havent seen anything to really write home about. I've been using this nearly 2 weeks, after washing my face nightly. The difference is... nominal. But, despite the lack of obvious skin changes, I really can't hate on my jade roller experience. It feels nice and I'll continue to use it to see if longevity increases its effects.
First time using a massager roller on the face, it is not too bad. I used to do face massaging motions with my hand and the roller seems to be more efficient and effective than the manual motion.

I ordered 5 of these for Christmas presents this year. It was such a great product to give to friends and family. They all loved it! It is very relaxing as well. Definitely put it in the freezer before use and use an essential oil in conjunction for full effect.

reviews.t: Very Cute and Practical Baby Shower Gift.

They come packaged in a very nice white cotton draw string bag with cute little baby boy on the front.  Inside the bag is a clear plastic bag containing the 4 bibs.  The front of each bib is made of 100% cotton and the backing is a very soft 100% polyester.  The backing would be very soft on the baby's bare skin if they were not wearing a shirt.  I like the fact that the maker took
When this product arrived only the small end actually rotated. The larger jade end was stiff and would not roll when moved against the skin.

We LOVE these bibs. I hemmed and hawed forever trying to find bibs for my son. He has a large neck and the ones I had did not fit him! These are perfect. He LOVES to suck on them so they are great for him to even wear all day as a drool catcher. His clothes stay dry which prevents extra outfit changes and these could not be cuter. I am in love with bandana bibs and so far these are my favorite! I love the soft feel and quality.

reviews.t: Results with no surgery or pain. AWESOME
reviews.x: I loved it. The scraping tool made my skin feel fresh and smooth. I saw a difference in small wrinkles around my mouth and forehead. The skin looked younger with less pores. I have told my friends about it. No surgery and a difference you could see and feel. Great no pain and easy to use. I will keep using it daily. Its not a cure all but for the price it works great. A great gift idea.
This thing works for puffiness and sleep wrinkles on my face. It also stays cool so it feels so good after a warm shower. My face absorbs my face cream so much better.
Cheap quality. Arrived broken. Other portion is squeaking when rolling. Returning it immediately.

I'm always buying bibs for shower gifts. It's my belief that one can never have too many bibs!  I got these Baby Bandana Drool and Dribble Bins for Boys for my grandson who is due this spring.   The bibs are adorable with the 4 different designs: *whales *airplanes *bicycle *sailboats  They have two snaps so they can be adjusted to baby's neck size. I would have loved this product if it hadn’t arrived with some cracks & a small chink in the larger roller. I tried using it once just to see what it was like & it was deeply relaxing, so I’m really disappointed about sending it back. Maybe it was a fluke, but I will be looking at other brands for a replacement.

reviews.t: Squeaks a little, bit gets the job done.
reviews.x: I’m still not 100% sure if I’m using it right, but I think it gets the job done well. The only thing I don’t like is the squeaky sound it makes sometimes when I’m rolling it. The size is comfortable, which I like.
Holy Crap these things are cute! My son is now a moustache'd bandit. He has now taken over 3 small saloons and has requested I refer to him as "Billy the Kid". 10/10 would buy again.
Came in the box in 2 pieces. One end looked like it had been secured with some cheap 2 sided tape and that end barely fit on it. Ended up returning for a credit
My jade roller smells like it came from the home of a heavy smoker. I cannot use it on my face, the stench is too overpowering. Will be returning.
I don't trust reviews that are supplied by people that got a free product, not reliable at all.
Ordered 1 and it broke immediately. Ordered a replacement and that one broke immediately
The large side of the roller snapped. I asked for a replacement... we'll see..
This product did not perform well so I would not buy it again!

I love these bibs!  My son really needs these, he is one and a bit messy. He has lots of teeth coming in and lots of sisters who enjoy feeding him lots things. They go on easily with a small snap on the back and stay put. They come off easily and the material is great. It's beathable and I can throw them right in the washing machine. They come witha nice cloth bag that has a draw string so I can keep them together. Nice and easy just like it should be. My son looks adorable and I am very happy.

claims.text: Most reviewers find the roller soothing, relaxing, and comfortable to use.
Several reviewers report that it helps their skin absorb serums, toners, and creams better and reduces greasiness or puffiness.
Some reviewers praise the build quality and durability, including surviving a drop to the floor.
A few reviewers report quality problems, such as a stiff roller end or the product arriving broken and squeaking.
Some reviewers note little to no visible skin results despite enjoying the experience.
